summary.text: Steven S. Choi represents the 37th District in the California State Senate.

paragraphs.text: Choi was born in Naju, South Korea, received a B.A. in English from Kyung Hee University, served in the South Korean military and was honorably discharged as a First Lieutenant, and later earned a master's degree in library science from Louisiana State University and a Ph.D. from the University of Pittsburgh.

He worked as a librarian, a USC assistant professor and a Korean-language instructor before serving as an Irvine Unified School District trustee, Irvine city councilman and mayor, State Assemblyman, and then State Senator.
